data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, October 14, 2026: Crypto prices sliding after higher-inflation report
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $83,092.65 on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, up 1.6% from Tuesday's open. As of 9:15 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin fell to $82,418.56. Ethereum opened at $2,496.22, up 2.1% from Tuesday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved down this morning to $2,461.69 as of 9:15 a.m. ET.
